verdict.rationale: Viam's docs say every component type exposes the same API regardless of brand (e.g. GetImage() for cameras, and likewise for motors, sensors and arms). They state that if you change a camera or motor in your config, your code keeps working, and that hardware added via driver modules behaves like any built-in component, with the SDKs working automatically. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that hardware swaps work without code changes in practice.
